news.title: Close Fights in Season 3
news.content: Current Season 3 is promising a close final phase as all tiers are still in contention for the top spots. In Tier I, FoxBrush manages to push ImpactDrake off the top spot whilst dropping TuskMammoth to unbelievable 7th place. The veteran is in risk of relegation as he has the same amount of points as 6th and 8th place with 5th place being 4 points away. Tier II has the most intense race for top spot as WeissTiger claims the lead with 11 points, only 3 points ahead of 4th place. GolemRock is still in bad form and with 0 points after 4 matches in risk of even dropping to Tier III, although only recently relegated from Tier I! HellsChain, to everyone's surprise, claims astonishing 14 points in 4 matches, securing him first place, closely followed by KnightMail with 13 and RhinoReaper with 12 points. Tier IV has a good distribution of season points across all places as all beys will struggle to not be relegated to the qualification pool for the next season. With only 3 matchdays left in the season, all beys will be looking to secure their spots in their respective tiers and avoid relegation.

news.title: Season 3 Qualifiers conclude!
news.content: The next season is just around the corner as the last three qualification tournaments have concluded. The first bey to follow TriceraPress into Tier IV is TyrannoBeat claiming a convincing victory in the Drop Attack Qualifiers against WizardRod (8-2) aftewr eliminating WhaleWave and EmperorMight prior to the final. DranDagger is able to stay in the competition after winning an exciting match against MeteorDragoon in the Xtreme Stadium Qualifiers I, while DranBuster makes his first ever appearance in the season lineup after winning the Xtreme Stadium Qualifiers II, eliminating newbie PhoenixFlare, prior contender CrimsonGaruda and finally CobaltDrake in the final. Thus the qualification process is complete and we can introduce TriceraPress, TyrannoBeat, DranDagger and DranBuster into the competition. With the season starting in a few weeks, the competition is heating up as the new beys will be looking to make their mark and climb up the tiers.

news.title: Welcome to Tier IV, TriceraPress!
news.content: Pre-Season hype is in full swing as the qualifiers started. The first of three qualification tournaments for the upcoming season 3 has concluded with TriceraPress claiming the title in the Double Xtreme Arena. The new challenger will be joining the Tier IV lineup for the next season, while the remaining 24 beys in the qualification pool will continue to fight for the remaining 3 spots in the next two tournaments, featuring a tournament in the unforgiving Drop Attack Beystadium.

news.title: FoxBrush back to former glory?
news.content: After finishing second in Tier I just behind TuskMammoth last season, FoxBrush showed morale and determination to claim the Season 2 Cup victory. After pushing TuskMammoth into the losers bracket in the semifinals and losing to him in the first final, FoxBrush managed to win the rematch and claim the title in a thrilling final.

news.title: Season 2 finishes with surprises
news.content: TuskMammoth finally breaks through and snatches his first ever title after a strong start into season 2 securing the top spot in Tier I and dethroning the former champion LeonCrest. Crest's struggles continue as he loses his relegation playoff match against CobaltDragoon demoting him to Tier II for the next season. Meanwhile, DranSword and CobaltDragoon promote from Tier II to Tier I. SilverWolf and PhoenixWing take the top 2 spots in Tier III and newcomer HellsBrave rushes through Tier IV to claim the title and promotion to Tier III, joined by WizardArc in second place. Check out the season summary for more details and stats.

news.title: Return of the spin stealer
news.content: Meteor L-Drago makes a comeback in form of a new bey, MeteorDragoon, staying true to its predecessor's looks in a x-ified design. Will this new bey be able to haunt the stadium in the same way as the original? Included in this patch are also PhoenixFlare and GhostCircle, two new beys who have yet to show their true potential.

news.title: LeonCrest struggles to find form in Season 2 opener
news.content: Season 2 has kicked off recently and former champion LeonCrest has had a tough start, losing his first two matches against the new contenders SharkScale and ValkyrieVolt. Dropping to last place in Tier 1, LeonCrest will need to regroup and find his form quickly to avoid relegation. Meanwhile S1 Tier III Champion ValkyrieVolt takes the lead in Tier I.

news.title: New beys added
news.content: Four new beys have been added to wiki and leaderboard: ShelterDrake, SamuraiCalibur, TriceraPress and SamuraiSteel.

news.title: Level & XP Progression System Live
news.content: A new progression layer is now live: per-match XP, performance and streak bonuses, prestige levels, tournament/season rewards, XP history transparency, and the new Levels leaderboard page.

news.title: RPG System Update
news.content: The RPG system has been adapted to introduce more variance and variety in stat results with better and more intuitive metrics.

news.title: ELO System Overhaul Live
news.content: The ELO system has been updated with EMA-based K-factor tuning and improved dynamic K scaling. Rankings are now more accurately reflecting true skill levels. Check the leaderboard to see the latest standings.

news.title: Season 2 Format Launched
news.content: The next upcoming season introduces 4 tiers of 8 beys and individual per-tier relegation and promotion. Get ready for more competitive play.

news.title: Season 1 Results
news.content: The first season has concluded! Check out the final standings and see who mastered each tier.

news.title: LeonCrest takes it home!
news.content: In an exciting final on last matchday of Season 1, LeonCrest manages to claim the top spot by scoring a last-second pocket finish to win against ImpactDrake and secure rank 1!
